description: Track every deal without the spreadsheet mess or CRM overhead. Dealboard gives salespeople, BD teams, founders, and other dealmakers one clear sales pipeline with deal cards, notes, goals, files, and reporting that works out of the box. In ChatGPT, Dealboard helps you quickly understand what is happening with each deal, see how you are pacing against your goals, add notes, update opportunities, and keep a close eye on the pipeline without digging through a spreadsheet or configuring a CRM.

defaultPrompt: What's in my pipeline right now?
